## The system

Organisation or project, and a public link if there is one.

## The boundary and its ambassador

Which external system or group does it represent, and which duties does it carry (contract, identity, policy, admission, journal, quarantine, fallback)?

## Configuration

- Grouping: one system / a group of systems
- Intelligence: scripted / assisted / autonomous planning
- Subscription offered: yes / no
- Deployment: stateless or durable; always on or on demand
